messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High 5xx rate detected on prod -> /v1/generate (inference-gateway). Error rate: 18% over 5m. Latency p95 increased from 120ms -> 850ms. PagerDuty PD#PD-8791 triggered.

Sara Liu: I'm on call. Acknowledging PD-8791. Triage in this thread.

Mike O'Connor: Seeing a bunch of worker restarts in runtime-cluster-02. k8s events show 'OOMKilled' then restart loop. Also some segfaults in model-runner logs.

Jen Park: Confirmed. Querying logs now — grep for 'segfault' and 'double free' shows repeated backtraces around the kv-cache flush path.

Kai Müller: Adding metrics: GPU eviction count spiked on node gpu-12 and gpu-14 at ~+200 evictions in 10m. Memory pressure traces show vram use jumping before each crash.

Alice Chen: Customer impact: multiple small customers reporting failed requests and a few enterprise customers seeing degraded SLAs. I've opened a support ticket for acct-42 with initial ETA note.

Nate Briggs: Quick mitigation idea: route traffic away from the affected cluster and upweight fallback model (cpu-based) until we stabilize. That buys time.

Sara Liu: Agreed. Executing runbook step: shift routing policy.

Sara Liu: ```
# reroute traffic to fallback pool
curl -X POST "https://console.internal.redwood.local/api/v1/routing/adjust" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"from":"inference-gateway/cluster-a","to":"fallback-cpu-pool","percent":60}'
```

incident-bot: Routing change accepted. 60% traffic to fallback-cpu-pool. New 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 6% in the first minute.

Mike O'Connor: Good. While that reduces surface, we still need root cause. I captured a backtrace from model-runner: ```
# snippet from /var/log/model-runner/crash.log
SIGSEGV at 0x0
#0  0x7f6b1a3d in kv_cache_flush+0x2f4
#1  0x7f6b1b12 in attention_cache_free+0x88
#2  0x563a2f9 in model_infer+0x3b1
```

Jen Park: The backtrace points at the quantized KV cache path. Recent deploy rolled out a new kernel that touches quantization allocs. Any recent kernel/quantization hotpatch?

Kai Müller: Yes — we pushed runtime v2.18.4 with the new quant alloc path ~30m before the spike. Rolling it back on a subset to test.

Alice Chen: Notifying impacted customers via banner & support. I'm drafting a status update.

Sara Liu: Rolling back runtime on one node group now: ```
kubectl -n runtime rollout undo daemonset/model-runner --to-revision=2 --selector=cluster=gpu-12
```

oncall-bot: Rollback job submitted. Watch pods for restarts.

Mike O'Connor: After rollback on gpu-12 the node stabilized and evictions stopped. Logs show no segfaults there. gpu-14 still flapping.

Jen Park: For live mitigation, disable quantized path via config flag until we fully validate: ```
kubectl -n runtime set configmap model-runner-config --from-literal=QUANT_ALLOC_ENABLED=false
kubectl -n runtime rollout restart daemonset/model-runner
```

incident-bot: Config change applied. New rollout initiated. Expected to finish in ~2 mins.

Kai Müller: After disabling quant alloc, error rate on gateway dropped to 2.1% and p95 latency down to ~230ms. We're stable-ish.

Nate Briggs: Good. Next steps: keep traffic partially on fallback while we validate rollback across clusters, collect heap dumps from affected nodes for postmortem.

Sara Liu: Collecting heap/vmcore from gpu-14 now. Command: ```
sudo cri-tools dump --container model-runner --output /tmp/core-gpu14.tar.gz
scp /tmp/core-gpu14.tar.gz ops@artifacts:/incidents/PD-8791/
```

Alice Chen: Posted initial customer-facing status: "We detected elevated error rates affecting generation requests. Traffic has been partially routed to fallback models. Engineers are investigating; we expect further updates within 30 minutes."

Sara Liu: Handoff plan: I'm stable on call for 30m, then will hand off to Jen Park for overnight coverage. Jen — you accept handoff?

Jen Park: Accepting. Summary for handoff: PD-8791 — 5xx spike caused by quantized KV cache segfault after v2.18.4; partial rollback + disable-quant flag applied; traffic 60% fallback->40% primary; heap/core captured from gpu-14; collecting more artifacts; customer comms posted. If error rate rises >5% alert me and escalate.

Sara Liu: Thanks. Leaving notes in the incident runbook and tagging Postmortem owners. @Mike O'Connor please own the root cause analysis + kernel diff. @Kai Müller please own reproducer on test infra.

Mike O'Connor: Will take RC analysis. I'll diff the runtime v2.18.4 changes and run the reproducer with forced kv-cache pressure.

incident-bot: PD-8791 updated: status -> "mitigated (partial)". Next update scheduled in 30m.

Nate Briggs: Logged action items in runbook: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/PD-8791/actions (collect logs, heapdumps, rollback validation, postmortem owner).

Sara Liu: Handoff complete. Jen — you're the on-call owner now.

Jen Park: Taking over. I'll post another update in 30. Good work team. :thumbsup:
